name: design-tools
description: The router: one targeted design pass on UI that already exists. Reads the request in the user's own words, picks exactly one specialist skill out of seventy-six across ui-craft, taste-skill, Emil Kowalski, Addy Osmani's web-quality suite and ibelick, and delegates to it. Carries what no single vendor has — a collision table for the twelve places where three vendors cover the same ground, read-only-before-write discipline, and a hard escalation threshold to design-pipeline when a request stops being one pass.
